work_packages.title: Secret Hygiene, .gitignore, Pinned Dependencies & Demo Seed Guard
acceptance_criteria: ID-005: AppConfig.validate_production_secrets() raises RuntimeError when ENV=production and secrets are missing or match known placeholders
ID-006: .gitignore exists and excludes .env, *.db, s3_vault/, worktrees/, evidence/, and __pycache__/
ID-020: requirements.txt pins exact == versions for all dependencies
ID-021: src/dashboard/app.py only seeds demo users when cfg.environment == 'development'

work_packages.title: PostgreSQL-Only Repository, Canonical Hash-Chain Parity, DB-Layer Trigger Enforcement, Optimistic Locking & Single SQL Seed Source
acceptance_criteria: ID-002 & ID-016: Zero sqlite3 imports or usage anywhere in src/ or tests/; all services route exclusively through PostgreSQL (psycopg + DATABASE_URL)
ID-008: PostgreSQL fn_canonical_jsonb() with COLLATE C and Python canonical_json() serialize JSONB keys and UTC microsecond timestamps identically
ID-009: complete_task_instance() enforces optimistic locking (WHERE instance_id = %s AND status <> 'Completed') and returns conflict when rowcount == 0
ID-010: PostgreSQL fn_audit_compute_hash_chain() BEFORE INSERT trigger computes prev_hash and row_hash at the database boundary and rejects forged row_hash or invalid prev_hash
ID-017: seed_tasks_from_sql_file() executes db/02_seed_tasks.sql directly against PostgreSQL as the single seed source
ID-022: PostgreSQL fn_audit_compute_hash_chain() uses pg_advisory_xact_lock(20261015, 1) instead of LOCK TABLE IN EXCLUSIVE MODE

work_packages.title: Entra ID Cryptographic OIDC Auth, GPhC Role Policy (MCA/DA/PT/Pharm + Read-Only Manager), PII Minimization & Dashboard Hardening
acceptance_criteria: ID-001: Dashboard removes staff impersonation selectbox and requires verified Microsoft Entra ID OIDC session or OAuth2 code exchange
ID-004: EntraIDAuthenticator.verify_id_token() cryptographically verifies RS256 JWT signature against JWKS public keys plus exp, iss, aud, and nonce
ID-007: docker-compose.yml publishes dashboard port strictly on host loopback 127.0.0.1:8501:8501
ID-011: StaffRole and PostgreSQL staff_role ENUM support Pharm, PT, Dispenser, MCA, and Manager; Manager has zero clinical task completion authority and read-only oversight
ID-012 & ID-028: Audit payloads omit gphc_reg_number PII, and dashboard audit tab is restricted to Pharm/Manager with identifier redaction for non-Pharmacists

work_packages.title: Slack Bolt Socket Mode & Signature Verification, APScheduler Tranche Cron, EOD-Scoped Closing Audit & Automatic Missed Transitions
acceptance_criteria: ID-003: build_bolt_app() and build_tranche_scheduler() wire Slack Bolt Socket Mode and APScheduler cron triggers for all 4 tranches plus nightly close_expired_periods
ID-018: CLOSING_AUDIT tranche escalates only End_Of_Day window tasks
ID-019: mark_overdue_instances_missed() transitions uncompleted past-period tasks to Missed and appends TASK_MISSED audit events
ID-024: verify_slack_request_signature() enforces HMAC-SHA256 v0 signature and 300s replay window at handler boundary

work_packages.title: Standard AES-256-GCM AEAD Encryption, Hetzner S3 boto3 & Databasus PGRSUS01 Verification, Nightly Cron Schedule, Non-Bypassable Break-Glass Gate & Native pg_dump
acceptance_criteria: ID-013: Replaces custom XOR stream cipher with standard AES-256-GCM AEAD + key versioning and verifies Databasus PGRSUS01 binary envelope
ID-003: Uploads and downloads encrypted .vault archives and .metadata sidecars via boto3 S3 client against Hetzner Object Storage
ID-014: Replaces tight restart loop with APScheduler nightly 22:15 schedule, signal-handled daemon loop, and has_backup_verified_for_date() idempotency guard
ID-023: Enforces mandatory non-bypassable SHA-256 hash-chain verification before and after Break-Glass PostgreSQL restore
ID-025: Executes PostgreSQL-native pg_dump --format=custom snapshot when pg_dump is available
